title: Leveraging Generative AI to Design Accessible Interactive Visualizations for Undergraduate Mathematics: A Six-Phase Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2608.28601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive visualizations support conceptual understanding in undergraduate mathematics, but building them has required programming expertise most instructors lack. Using a design-based research approach, we develop, deploy, and evaluate a six-phase workflow (Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control) that uses generative AI to build WCAG~2.2 Level~AA compliant visualizations without programming. The six phases structure every prompt, scaffold the AI's code generation, and define where human verification is applied. We ask whether the structure reliably yields correct and accessible tools, whether it runs both backward (reverse-engineering prompts from a finished tool) and forward (generating a tool from a plain-language idea), and what verification each phase requires. translated_title: 利用生成式人工智能为本科数学设计无障碍交互式可视化：一个六阶段工作流
translated_abstract: 交互式可视化有助于促进本科数学中的概念理解，但构建这些可视化需要大多数教师所不具备的编程专业知识。采用基于设计的研究方法，我们开发、部署并评估了一个六阶段工作流（基础、定制、数学深度、应用、无障碍性、教学控制），该工作流利用生成式人工智能在无需编程的情况下构建符合 WCAG 2.2 AA 级标准的可视化。这六个阶段为每个提示提供结构，为人工智能的代码生成提供支架，并定义了在何处应用人工验证。我们探讨这种结构是否能可靠地产生正确且无障碍的工具，它是否能双向运行（从成品工具逆向推导提示，以及从自然语言描述正向生成工具），以及每个阶段需要何种验证。在涵盖微积分、多元微积分和微分方程的四个已部署工具中，我们评估了数学……
tldr: 该研究提出了一个六阶段工作流，利用生成式人工智能使不具备编程能力的教师也能构建符合 WCAG 2.2 AA 无障碍标准的本科数学交互式可视化工具，并验证了该工作流的可靠性与双向可用性。
en_tdlr: This study presents a six-phase workflow leveraging generative AI that enables instructors without programming expertise to reliably build accessible, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant interactive visualizations for undergraduate mathematics, operating in both forward and reverse directions.
